notes: Nevada's joint business registration (Department of Taxation sales/use tax permit and the Employment Security Division's unemployment insurance account). Addresses print whole on one line. Owners: name as 'Last, First MI'; dates MM/DD/YYYY. Business activities: name every one that applies ('Retail Sales - New, Service'). The SSN or ITIN boxes are never printed; the signer writes them. The acquisition details, filing frequency, payment and security boxes, the consolidated-account and contact pages and the signatures and dates are left for the signer.
